column1: # best-config.tsv — the SINGLE UNIFORM forst-rs config applied to EVERY NexMark query.
# ★★ UNIFORM CONFIG (2026-06-17, PMC-1 — user directive). PER-QUERY CONFIG IS
# FORBIDDEN. There is exactly ONE config row (`*`) and run-best.sh applies it to
# every query identically. The old per-query split (q9 KV-sep OFF, q11/q17 KV-sep
# OFF, others ON, q17 routing-adaptive) has been PURGED. KV-sep is uniformly ON;
# the engine adapts to the query SHAPE at runtime (see "ENGINE AUTO-SELECTS" below)
# — there are no per-query branches in this file or in run-best.sh.
# WHY UNIFORM IS NOW CORRECT (the levers that made it possible this campaign):
#   1. SLOTS load-balance (taskmanager.load-balance.mode=SLOTS, in every backend
#      template) spreads the 4 subtasks 2+2 across both TMs. This fixed the slot-
#      skew that OOM-killed q9/q19 (all 4 join subtasks had packed onto tm1 -> tm1
#      held 100% of state -> 16g/TM cgroup OOM though cluster total was ~17 GiB).
#   2. process.size=10240m carve-out (config-forst-rs-local.yaml.tpl) leaves ~6 GiB
#      of the 16g/TM cgroup free for the engine's NATIVE (jemalloc-in-the-.so)
#      allocation that Flink does NOT budget. q9 + KV-sep ON now fits 16g/TM.
#   3. FRS_VLOG_POINT_DEREF auto-follows KV-sep when unset (db.rs:445-470): under
#      uniform KV-sep ON the scattered windowed-agg RMW (q11/q17) routes a ≤1-ptr
#      deref through get_point (reads exactly the value bytes, not a 64 KiB chunk)
#      -> recovers q11/q17 to near-OFF parity. This is what made "KV-sep ON for the
#      windowed queries too" perf-clean, removing the old q11/q17 OFF exception.
#   4. FRS_MEM_MANAGER=1 (never-OOM controller) derives ONE engine-native budget
#      from the cgroup and bounds blockcache/wbm/shadow/vlog/compaction + arms the
#      compaction-admission + windowed levers + proactive jemalloc purge. On a box
#      with real headroom (>=40 GiB, the remote Linux box) it runs un-throttled and
#      is perf-neutral; it only sheds under genuine cgroup pressure.
# ENGINE AUTO-SELECTS BY QUERY SHAPE (one config, runtime-adaptive — no per-query):
#   - Windowed point-RMW (q11/q17): FRS_VLOG_POINT_DEREF (auto-on under KV-sep) ->
#     exact-size point deref.
#   - Scan/coalesceable joins (q4/q7/q19/q20): FRS_VLOG_COALESCE_DEREF batches the
#     deferred BlobRef derefs per segment; multi-pointer groups take get_coalesced.
#   The SAME env produces both paths; the engine picks per deref by locality.
# TOPOLOGY (uniform, every query): TOPO=split — 2x TM 4c/16g + 1x JM 2c/4g (the
# committed 8c/32g-TM-budget split). parallelism=4, numberOfTaskSlots=4, SLOTS.
# KNOB NAMES verified against the engine (crates/forst-rs-engine/src/db.rs):
#   FRS_KV_SEPARATION       1|true => ON (default OFF)                  db.rs:17598
#   FRS_KV_MIN_BLOB_SIZE    bytes, default 256, floor 22               db.rs (min-blob)
#   FRS_TRIVIAL_MOVE        1|true => ON (default OFF)
#   FRS_RS_S2_PINNED        1|true => ON (default OFF)
#   FRS_VLOG_COALESCE_DEREF 1|true => ON (default OFF)                  db.rs:335
#   FRS_VLOG_POINT_DEREF    1|true|0 — UNSET => auto-follows KV-sep     db.rs:467
#   FRS_VLOG_READER_CACHE_CAP   handle cap, default 2048               db.rs:148
#   FRS_VLOG_RESIDENT_BUDGET_MB resident vlog byte budget, default     db.rs:176
#   FRS_KV_ADAPTIVE_PRESSURE 1 => back off separation under budget     db.rs:228
#   FRS_MEM_MANAGER         1 => arm the never-OOM controller          db.rs:4588
#   FRS_SST_COMPRESSION     none|lz4|zstd (engine default + ForSt match = lz4)
# EXCLUDED FROM THE UNIFORM DEFAULT (documented — NOT safe to fold into one config):
#   - FRS_RS_EXECUTOR=routing-adaptive (R2a): historically helped q11/q17 but is a
#     Flink-side path selector; under uniform KV-sep ON + point-deref the q11/q17
#     read path is already recovered, so we leave the executor at its inline default
#     (no per-query executor switch). Operators may still set it manually to probe.
#   - FRS_S2_FANOUT_MIN=8 (R1 adaptive-S2) / FRS_RS_PROBE_BLOOM_PRUNE /
#     FRS_RS_LEVELED_HOT_CF / FRS_PERSISTENT_PROBE_ITER / FRS_RS_MERGE_RMW: these
#     were the experimental per-query "validate full-stack" levers. They are NOT in
#     the uniform default because they were never A/B-confirmed query-by-query as
#     uniformly safe (some help joins, none were shown harmless for windowed/source-
#     bound queries). The uniform config keeps only the levers proven beneficial-or-
#     neutral across shapes (KV-sep + coalesce + auto point-deref + the bounds).
#   - per-query process.size / topology: FORBIDDEN. Every query uses the SAME
#     2x4c/16g split + 10240m carve-out.
# HONEST CEILING (the Mac 35 GiB VM, NOT the remote box): on the 37.77 GiB Mac VM
# two co-resident 16g TMs overcommit the VM, so q9/q5/q19 can OOM from GLOBAL VM
# pressure (jemalloc RETAINED rides RSS over the cgroup; the LIVE set always fits
# the budget). On a host whose VM actually fits 2x16g (>=40 GiB) the controller
# runs un-throttled -> never-OOM AND within-bar. See the repro doc + the
# 8c32g-3backend-sweep-results.md PMC-1 sections for the empirical detail.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated):
#   query  KV_SEPARATION  KV_MIN_BLOB_SIZE  TRIVIAL_MOVE  S2_PINNED  VLOG_COALESCE_DEREF  SST_COMPRESSION  MEM_MANAGER  note
#   query "*" = the UNIFORM config; run-best.sh applies this row to EVERY query.

column9: UNIFORM config for ALL queries. KV-sep ON; FRS_VLOG_POINT_DEREF left UNSET so it auto-follows KV-sep (windowed point-RMW q11/q17 take exact-size point deref; coalesceable joins q4/q7/q19/q20 take get_coalesced) — the engine auto-selects by deref locality. FRS_MEM_MANAGER=1 never-OOM controller (un-throttled on the >=40 GiB remote box, perf-neutral). TOPO=split 2x4c/16g + 10240m carve-out + SLOTS (in templates). Vlog resident bounds (reader_cap 2048, budget 256m, adaptive pressure) keep the engine native inside the carve-out headroom. NO per-query differences.
